title: Alloy Armoury
description:
[BETA]
Alloy Armoury adds unique alloy ingots which are used to create tools and armours!
body:
# ALLOY ARMOURY
Alloy Armoury adds unique alloys into Minecraft which allows players to have more diverse equipment!


The mod currently has:
- Brass
- Bronze
- Steel
- High Carbon Steel
- Enderite
  
And many more to come! Including dimensional alloys!

Texture work by Dr. Panda!
